Fuel, reserve,燃料、储备、 and the current between them与二者之间的电流

Most tokens do one thing badly. Spark does three things deliberately — and the loop is the reason all three are the same asset. 大多数代币连一件事都做不好。Spark 有意做三件事 —— 而回路正是"三件事用同一种资产"的原因。

02 / SPARKECONOMY WHERE FUEL BECOMES LITERAL燃料的字面意义

The meter is计量表 in the protocol, not the fine print写在协议里，而非小字里

Engine's SparkEconomy module derives hard budgets from a 100Mbps relay baseline. These numbers are code — metered on-device, not enforced by fine print. Engine 的 SparkEconomy 模块从 100Mbps 中继基线推导硬预算。这些数字就是代码 —— 在设备端计量，而非靠小字条款。

Budget预算Ceiling上限Meaning含义
metering rate10 SPARK / KBEvery kilobyte burns — rounded up, floor of 10 per message每 KB 燃烧 —— 向上取整，单条最低 10
text message40 KBA novel fits; a firehose doesn't装得下一部小说，装不下消防水管
media message48 KBEmoji & photos travel lean表情与照片轻装上路
envelope ceiling128 KBHard outer bound per frame每帧外部硬上限
group size200 members人Derived from relay throughput math由中继吞吐推导
baseline100 MbpsThe physics every budget derives from一切预算的物理来源
ANTI-SPAM BY THERMODYNAMICS用热力学反垃圾 When every byte burns fuel, a botnet's economics invert: spamming a stranger costs real Spark, while your own speech flows inside budget. No moderation queue required — physics moderates. 当每个字节都燃烧燃料，僵尸网络的经济就反转了：骚扰陌生人要付出真 Spark，而你自己的表达在预算内畅行。不需要审核队列 —— 物理就是审核员。

04 / FAQ

Fair questions,合理的问题， straight answers坦率的回答

Do I need Spark to chat in Engine?在 Engine 聊天需要 Spark 吗？Daily messaging lives comfortably inside standing budgets. Spark becomes visible when you push media, run big groups or build on the SDK.日常消息在既有预算内绰绰有余。当你推送媒体、运营大群或在 SDK 上开发时，Spark 才会显形。
When can I trade Spark on a DEX?什么时候能在 DEX 交易 Spark？At TGE. Each IDO wallet can claim 25% up front (the rest vests linearly over 9 months), and 10% of supply seeds the DEX pool paired with BNB. Token and pool addresses are published on this page the moment they deploy — until then no Spark is tradable, and any address claiming otherwise is fake.TGE 时。每个 IDO 钱包可先领取 25%（其余 9 个月线性释放），10% 供给注入与 BNB 配对的 DEX 池。代币与池地址将在部署后第一时间公示于本页 —— 在此之前不存在可交易的 Spark，任何声称反之的地址都是假的。
What backs Spark?Spark 的支撑是什么？Real usage physics: every message in the application layer consumes it, and the DAO's treasury holds it long-term. Utility first, reserve second, narrative never.真实的使用物理：应用层的每条消息都在消耗它，DAO 金库长期持有它。先是效用，再是储备，从不讲故事。
Can AI stewards spend my Spark?AI 管家能动用我的 Spark 吗？No. Stewards operate only on reserve-side liquidity, inside charter bounds, with receipts. Personal keys sit offline in Vault — outside any AI's reach by physics.不能。管家只操作储备侧流动性，在宪章边界内并留回执。个人密钥离线沉睡于 Vault —— 物理上就不在 AI 可及之处。

The loop is auditable.回路是可审计的。

Read the code, run a node, hold the fuel. The protocol stack, the governance kernel and the P2P substrate are public — audit them, then join. 读代码、跑节点、持燃料。协议栈、治理内核与 P2P 基座均已公开 —— 先审计，再加入。
